nagai.name: Nagai Food Map
nagai.hero_title:
Explore the flavors of Nagai,

nagai.description: A food guide to Nagai, the town of the Kurojishi lion dance and irises, with every eatery pinned on a map.
nagai.subtitle: Stories about the tastes of Nagai, collected on a map
nagai.about: A food guide to eateries in Nagai, Yamagata, based on social posts by visitors, presented together with a map. Cover images are AI-created watercolor illustrations; see the embedded original posts for actual photos of the food.

nagai:niku-no-ooba-nagai.title: Nagai City's "Niku no Ooba" — A butcher shop boasting freshness, cutting meat only after an order is placed
nagai:niku-no-ooba-nagai.summary: "Niku no Ooba," a butcher shop in Kunomoto, Nagai City. Founded in 1975 and run by two generations of a family, it is also a designated Yonezawa beef retailer and offers domestic horse sashimi (basashi). The post features horse sashimi packed with garlic.
nagai:niku-no-ooba-nagai.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of horse sashimi (basashi) and meat
nagai:niku-no-ooba-nagai.markdown:
This is "Niku no Ooba" in Kunomoto, Nagai City.

Founded in 1975, this community-rooted butcher shop has been run by two generations of a family, specializing in Yonezawa beef and domestic horse meat. Their commitment is to slice each piece individually upon order, rather than displaying it in a showcase. In a post, the horse sashimi (basashi) is described as "the best." A culture of eating horse meat has long been rooted in Nagai, and the horse meat chashu is also a local specialty.

You can find the shop's location and business hours on Google Maps via "Shop Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@k_kudo_1980/post/DORpnJjE5G0)

nagai:nikusyo-endo-nagai.title: Nagai City's "Nikusho Endo" — A Horse Sashimi (Basashi) and Yonezawa Beef Butcher Shop
nagai:nikusyo-endo-nagai.summary: "Nikusho Endo," a butcher shop in Koide, Nagai City. Operating under the motto "Deliciousness starts with 'go-en'," it is known for its purely domestic horse sashimi (basashi) and Yonezawa beef. Posts rave about the garlic-rich horse sashimi.
nagai:nikusyo-endo-nagai.markdown:
This is Nikusho Endo, located in Koide, Nagai City.

This butcher shop purchases whole cattle, horses, and pigs and selects them based on its own standards; its signature dish is Nagai's famous horse sashimi (basashi). Posts describe the sashimi as "the best" and "packed with garlic."

You can find the shop's location and business hours on Google Maps via "Shop Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@k_kudo_1980/post/DOVyRYYk4iP)

nagai:saito-fuya-nagai.title: Nagai City's "Saito Fuya" — A Japanese-style cafe run by a wheat gluten shop founded in the Taisho era
nagai:saito-fuya-nagai.summary: "Saito Fuya" in Narita, Nagai City. This Japanese-style cafe is run by a long-established fu shop founded in 1926; the post features "Fu Shop Lunch" (1,500 yen) and fu sweets.
nagai:saito-fuya-nagai.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of a wheat gluten lunch
nagai:saito-fuya-nagai.markdown:
This is Saito Fuya in Narita, Nagai City.

This Japanese-style cafe is run by a long-established fu shop founded in 1926, and the post highlights the "Fu Shop Lunch" (1,500 yen). In addition to dishes featuring carefully selected fu, their fu sweets are also recommended.

Business hours are 11:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and the shop is closed on Wednesdays and Thursdays (as of the time of posting). You can check the shop's location on Google Maps via "Shop Location" at the bottom of this article.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@gatts_yamagata.trip/post/DRhMqn8At5W)

nagai:takasaka-shokudo-nagai.title: Nagai City's "Takasaka Shokudo" — The signature dish is hearty katsu curry
nagai:takasaka-shokudo-nagai.summary: Takasaka Shokudo is a traditional diner in Kunomoto, Nagai City. The katsu curry (regular serving, 1,050 yen including tax) featured in the post is a signature dish frequently mentioned as a standout in reviews on sites like Tabelog.
nagai:takasaka-shokudo-nagai.markdown:
This is Takasaka Shokudo, located in Kunomoto, Nagai City.

The post features a regular serving of katsu curry (¥1,050, tax included). This restaurant is well-regarded for its hearty, diner-style portions and classic curry. Its wide menu—including katsudon and ramen sets—is another reason why it is so beloved by locals.

You can find the restaurant's location and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article (it is closed on Mondays).

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@aki_special_sweet/post/De7yVNXk_t7)

nagai:tonchinkan-nagai.title: Nagai City's "Yakiniku Tonchinkan" — Yakiniku at night, tonkatsu and cold noodles by day
nagai:tonchinkan-nagai.summary: "Yakiniku Tonchinkan" in Tatemachi-minami, Nagai City. The longest-running yakiniku restaurant in Nagai, it also boasts popular lunch options featuring tonkatsu and cold noodles, such as the loin tonkatsu set (1,000 yen) featured in the post.
nagai:tonchinkan-nagai.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of a tonkatsu set meal and yakiniku
nagai:tonchinkan-nagai.markdown:
This is "Yakiniku Tonchinkan," located in Tatemachi-minami, Nagai City.

The post featured the pork loin tonkatsu set meal. This is a long-established restaurant in Nagai where you can enjoy yakiniku—primarily Yonezawa and Yamagata beef—at night, and a tonkatsu set with carefully selected pork and cold noodles at lunch.

You can find the restaurant's location and business hours on Google Maps via "Restaurant Location" at the bottom of this article (the restaurant is closed on Mondays).

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@aki_special_sweet/post/DX3qkxbk01P)

nagai:treats-nagai.title: Rice Flour Chiffon from "Treats" in Nagai City — A treat you can only find once a month
nagai:treats-nagai.summary: "Treats" offers oil-free rice flour chiffon cakes and baked goods. Rather than having a permanent storefront, products are sold once a month at locations such as inside the Maruru hair salon in Imaizumi, Nagai City. The address provided indicates the sales location in Nagai.
nagai:treats-nagai.cover_alt: Watercolor-style illustration of a rice flour chiffon cake
nagai:treats-nagai.markdown:
"Treats" offers oil-free rice flour chiffon cakes and baked goods, baked in a rental kitchen in Kaminoyama City.

While there are no permanent stores, there are sales days once a month in Nagai City. The locations mentioned in the post are inside "Beauty Salon Maruru" in Imaizumi, Nagai City (from 10:30 AM), and "Furusato Shop" on the grounds of the roadside station in Iide Town (from 9:00 AM, very limited quantities). The pin and address in this article indicate the Nagai location, Beauty Salon Maruru.

Sales dates and product lineups vary by month, and notifications regarding reservations are posted on the store's Instagram Stories. Customers are encouraged to bring their own ice packs and insulated bags.

Source: [Threads post](https://www.threads.com/@treats_k5i11k8/post/DevmW83gXnE)
